query: INSERT INTO manifestations (library_id, work_id, format, file_path, ingestion_file_hash, current_file_hash, file_size_bytes, ingestion_status, validation_status) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM libraries WHERE configuration_key = 'default'), $1, 'epub'::manifestation_format, $2, $3, $3, 1000, 'complete'::ingestion_status, 'clean'::validation_status) RETURNING id
